suiteVersion.description: Semver of the testatlas npm package that wrote this manifest.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the _testatlas/ workspace; bumped by migrations.

target.description: Absolute target path captured at install time (informational only; uninstall always uses cwd).

mode.description: Optional. Set to 'global' when this manifest tracks a `--global` install (target == os.homedir() and adapter command files live under user-home). Project-local installs omit the field entirely (default-local for backwards compat).

path.description: Target-relative POSIX path (forward-slashes only; backslashes rejected for cross-platform discipline).

hash.description: 16-hex SHA-256 of file content (CRLF-normalized via content-hash.js).

source.description: Suite-relative POSIX path of the source file in the testatlas package.
